objective: Classify the ternary projections of the common unpinned Boolean prefix for arbitrary literal signs. Test whether a four-choice observation detects and reconstructs relative signs among occurrences of one variable.
status: Proved: For every signing of the unpinned prefix, exactly the displayed triples have a proper projection, each with seven allowed states. A four-private-bit projection reads the relative signs of two occurrences of one variable, and a linear number of such comparisons recovers the signs up to variable complementation.
title: What three and four open choices reveal about opposite requirements
